data.notes: June 2027 is still early-announcement territory: confirmed events are led by major festivals and arena concerts, while Paris club and underground calendars are not yet published this far out.

events.title: We Love Green 2027
events.summary: Paris’s flagship eco-minded contemporary music festival returns to Bois de Vincennes for three days. The 2027 dates are confirmed, while the lineup is still to be announced.

events.title: Tame Impala
events.summary: Tame Impala plays two Accor Arena shows with an in-the-round stage setup. Wet Leg is confirmed as support.

events.title: Fun Radio Ibiza Experience 2027
events.summary: Fun Radio Ibiza Experience returns to Accor Arena for its 11th edition. The venue describes it as an arena-scale electronic music show featuring major DJs.

events.title: Tayc — JOŸA Tour
events.summary: Tayc plays three nights at Accor Arena on the JOŸA Tour. The venue bills him as a leading figure in French R&B and the Afrolove movement.

events.title: Don Omar — The Last King World Tour
events.summary: Reggaeton pioneer Don Omar returns to France with The Last King World Tour. Accor Arena confirms the Paris show for June 25, 2027.

events.title: blink-182
events.summary: blink-182 performs a one-off Paris-area arena show in Nanterre, produced by Live Nation. The official venue page confirms the June 15 date at Plenitude Arena.

events.title: Hayley Williams
events.summary: Hayley Williams brings The Hayley Williams Show to Zénith Paris - La Villette for a single Paris date. The venue notes it is her return after appearing at We Love Green the previous year.

events.title: Pépélé Festival
events.summary: Afrobeats and Amapiano-focused summer festival/night with international DJ Skyla Tylaa, positioned as a diaspora dance-music event for Fête de la Musique weekend energy.

events.title: Médine — Enfants du destin
events.summary: French rapper Médine brings an acoustic concert version of Enfants du destin to Salle Pleyel. The show revisits one of the major narrative song cycles from his catalogue.

events.title: Meiway & Le Zo-Gang
events.summary: Ivorian star Meiway brings Le Zo-Gang to Zénith Paris - La Villette for a one-night Paris show. The venue frames it as a career-spanning celebration of his Zoblazo catalogue.

events.title: Yanns — Phénoménal Re-Tour
events.summary: Yanns plays Dôme de Paris on the Phénoménal Re-Tour. The venue highlights a new staging and a high-energy show built around his pop-urban hits.

events.title: Médine - Enfant du Destin
events.summary: A seated/acoustic Paris date from veteran French rapper Médine, reworking his politically charged Enfants du destin song cycle in an intimate concert-theatre format.

events.title: Joe Hisaishi symphonique
events.venueName: Grande salle Pierre Boulez - Philharmonie de Paris
events.summary: The Philharmonie ticketing page confirms two performances of Joe Hisaishi symphonique on June 9 and 10, 2027. This is a major orchestral draw for film-music and symphonic audiences in Paris.

events.title: Souffle de vie — Ensemble intercontemporain / ManiFeste-2027
events.venueName: Salle des concerts - Cité de la musique
events.summary: Ensemble intercontemporain performs Souffle de vie as part of ManiFeste-2027, Ircam’s contemporary-music festival. The programme includes works by Tristan Murail, Philippe Leroux, Luigi Nono and Sarah Nemtsov with live electronics.

events.title: Toujours Vivant — 500 choristes chantent avec Johnny Hallyday
events.summary: This large-scale Johnny Hallyday tribute pairs his original voice and projected images with 500 Voices Harmony choristers and live musicians. Accor Arena confirms the Paris date for June 27, 2027.

events.title: Gypsy Maestros — Des Balkans au Danube
events.venueName: Grande salle Pierre Boulez - Philharmonie de Paris
events.summary: Gypsy Maestros opens the Philharmonie’s Les Balkans focus with musicians from Bucharest and Budapest, including Mónika Lakatos and Roby Lakatos. The concert is confirmed for June 23, 2027 at 8:00 pm.

events.title: Maki Namekawa — Autour de Joe Hisaishi
events.venueName: Grande salle Pierre Boulez - Philharmonie de Paris
events.summary: Pianist Maki Namekawa performs a film- and contemporary-music programme around Joe Hisaishi, Philip Glass, Ryuichi Sakamoto and Toru Takemitsu. The Philharmonie listing confirms the concert for June 7, 2027 at 8:00 pm.

events.title: De la tambura à la guitare manouche — Bako Jovanović / Sébastien Giniaux
events.summary: Serbian tambura virtuoso Bako Jovanović meets French guitarist Sébastien Giniaux for a Balkan and manouche-rooted concert. The Philharmonie listing confirms the date as June 25, 2027 at 8:00 pm.

events.title: Bal Balkans
events.summary: A free participatory Balkan dance event spotlighting music from Bulgaria, Turkey, North Macedonia, Bosnia, Greece and beyond, led by professional and amateur musicians.
